newsitem.title: UK: India seen pressed to reach forecast sugar output.
newsitem.headline: India seen pressed to reach forecast sugar output.

text.p: India could struggle to reach its official sugar output forecast of 13 million tonnes white value as few factories are still open at the end of this season's crop, E D & F Man said in a report on Monday.
Just six factories were open by June 15, compared with 168 at the same stage last year, Man said.
Projections for next year continued to suggest a much lower crop and speculation was mounting about the potential level of exports for next season, it added.

In its previous report, Man estimated Indian sugar production at 13 million tonnes for 1996/97 after the bumper 13.2 million turned out the previous year. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
